description:
Cast Chain Lightning by paying {R}, dealing 3 damage to Raphael and then causing you to pay {R}{R} to copy Chain Lightning, with the copy targeting Raphael.
Raphael triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Chain Lightning copy, dealing 3 damage to Raphael and then causing you to pay {R}{R} to copy Chain Lightning, with the copy targeting Raphael.
Repeat from step 2.
